**Evaluation:** Evaluate the NeRF-SH model to obtain $\sigma$ values on a uniformly spaced 3D grid.
**Filtering:** Render alpha maps for all training views using the voxel grid derived from the evaluation step.
**Coefficient Aggregation:** Compute the mean of the density and SH coefficients obtained from the 256 sampled points.
Convert PlenOctree child nodes $p_{oct}$ to voxelized point cloud positions $p_{pc}$ in a voxel grid of depth $R$: $p_{pc} = p_{oct} \times 2^R - 0.5$.
Convert local voxel coordinates to world positions and compute the visibility mask $O$ using the general visibility algorithm.
Prune voxels based on the visibility mask $O$ and MVE parameter $\nu$.
Convert the pruned point cloud $M$ back to a PlenOctree $\hat{G}$.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Depends on the sparsity of the scene and the threshold $\tau_w$.
